module.purpose: Provides the interactive canvas view for a single comment thread, including displaying comments, composing replies, editing and deleting comments, resolving threads, copying thread links, and reporting read receipts.
module.summary: This React module coordinates the thread popover UI with tldraw editor state, commenting mutations, permission checks, draft persistence, focus management, mobile placement, and host-provided component slots. It memoizes derived comment cards, gates write actions by identity and permissions, preserves unsent reply drafts, reports unread comments in batches, and exposes link and positioning helpers for canvas integration.
module.businessContext: Supports collaborative in-canvas review and discussion workflows. If it fails, users cannot read, reply to, manage, resolve, or navigate comment threads reliably.
functions: useResolveName (~L56-58): Creates a stable author-name resolver for rich-text rendering.
absoluteThreadLink (~L64-70): Resolves relative thread links against the current document URL.
useCopyLink (~L73-87): Copies thread links and manages temporary copied confirmation state.
toCardProps (~L89-109): Converts comment records into rendered comment-card properties.
ThreadPopover (~L130-158): Portals and positions an interactive thread popover above the canvas.
ThreadView (~L169-574): Coordinates thread rendering, composing, permissions, mutations, focus, and read receipts.
postReply (~L289-306): Creates, commits, clears, and reports a new thread reply.
toggleResolve (~L308-312): Resolves or reopens the current thread for the signed-in user.
removeThread (~L315-317): Deletes the current thread through the editor mutation layer.
startEdit (~L324-334): Captures return focus and enters comment editing mode.
saveEdit (~L336-341): Validates and commits edits to the selected comment.
renderComment (~L344-450): Renders either an edit composer or an interactive comment card.

io: Writes resolved thread URLs to the browser clipboard.

detail.signature: function ThreadView({ editor, thread, ...props }: CommentingContext & { editor: Editor; thread: TLCommentThread })

The supplied CommentingContext callbacks and components conform to their declared contracts.
postconditions: The thread UI is rendered with the current comments and resolved state.
Unread visible comments are reported in one batch when onCommentsRead is provided.
A non-empty reply is committed only when currentUserId is present and commenting is permitted.
An edit is committed only for an existing comment and non-empty edit text.
Resolve, reopen, delete, copy-link, dismiss, and focus actions are exposed only under their applicable conditions.
invariants: Reply submission is unavailable for an unidentified viewer or a resolved thread.
Comment edit and delete affordances are limited by canComment and the per-comment permissions map.
Thread deletion is limited by canComment and the delete-thread permission.
Resolve and reopen actions require both commenting permission and currentUserId.
An unsent reply draft is stored per thread id and is cleared after a successful reply commit.
Unread comment ids are reported together rather than one callback per comment.
The thread link action is shown only when getThreadHref returns a value.
Tab interception is limited to an unmodified Tab whose target is the thread container or document body.
edgeCases: An empty or whitespace-equivalent reply is ignored and does not mutate the editor or draft.
A reply from a viewer without currentUserId is ignored.
A resolved thread removes the reply composer even when the viewer otherwise can comment.
An empty edit or an edit for a comment no longer present in comments is ignored.
When there are no unread comments, onCommentsRead is not called.
When no onCommentsRead callback is supplied, read receipts are not reported.
When getThreadHref is absent or returns undefined, the copy-link menu item is omitted.
Pressing Escape while editing cancels editing without saving.
Closing and reopening a thread restores the saved reply draft for that thread id.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Invalid or empty reply/edit content and missing required identity are ignored without a write. Exceptions from editor mutations or host callbacks are not caught.
errorPolicy.returnsOnError: No rendered error value; invalid actions are no-ops.

preconditions: index identifies an existing comment in comments.
card contains the presentation properties required by CommentCardProps.
postconditions: Returns a ReactNode representing the selected comment.
When the selected comment is being edited, the returned node contains an edit composer initialized with the current edit text.
When the selected comment is not being edited, the returned node contains a CommentCard with reactions and conditionally available comment actions.
invariants: The rendered comment identity is taken from comments[index].
Comment reactions receive the current user identity only when canComment is true; otherwise they receive null.
Edit and delete actions are only exposed when canComment is true and the corresponding permission exists.
edgeCases: When editingId equals the selected comment id, renders the editing composer instead of the regular comment card.
When editText is empty according to isCommentEmpty, the editing composer is disabled for submission.
When canComment is false, reactions are rendered read-only and comment actions are omitted.
When permissions are absent or neither edit nor delete is granted, the more-options menu is omitted.
When index does not identify an existing comment, accessing the selected comment's properties fails rather than producing a fallback node.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit validation or fallback is performed; an invalid comment index can cause a runtime error while reading the selected comment.
